input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (owner's standing ventures brief)
errors: git ls-tree -l on a blob:none clone fetched blobs one by one and hung past the 120 s timeout; stopped it and used a sparse checkout instead
first mutation run timed out: assertEqual on 12,000-element lists spends minutes in difflib; tests now compare by mismatch count

CI lint (mypy) failed on the first push: my tile variable reused the name `t`, which already held the Track, and a list needed an annotation. Fixed, and checked locally with CI's pinned ruff 0.15.8 and mypy 1.19.1

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing's BUILDABLE names raw.pixls.us as serving files with curl -L; this session it answered CONNECT 403 again, the same as several earlier runs
a bare python3 lacks pytest (as noted), but the venture's tests run fine under python3 -m unittest with PYTHONPATH=src:tests; saying so would have saved a step

deviations.why: No real tiled CR3 was reachable, so I couldn't take the 'a tiled CR3' item as written (a real file).
deviations.did: Implemented lossless tiles and checked them with LibRaw as an independent oracle: real R8 frames re-tiled and spliced back into the real container.
deviations.result: 0 sensels differ on 6 files; a wrong-order control is caught by both readers. A real R5 file is still listed as wanted.

notes: Local verification: test_cr3, test_cr3_wavelet and test_ffmpeg_pipeline OK (49 tests). Full discover: 1,186 of 1,187 pass; the one error is the container's broken system PIL (_imaging import), which this change doesn't touch. LibRaw 0.22 (rawpy) tiled check exit 0, control caught. Six hand mutations of the tile code: five caught after the fixture fix; the plane-vs-subband byte count mutation is equivalent on all data seen. CI-equivalent run_venture_tests photo-editing: 1187 tests OK. venture-preflight clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an experienced raw-decoder engineer: read LibRaw's tile layout, implement and test tiled CRX decode, build a splice-based oracle check: about a day and a half

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
